correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Cayley group G of 2^(d-1) even-weight words, its character-dual quotient by the all-ones vector, adjacency energies ((d-2|a|)^2-d)/2 and complete energy coincidence criterion |a|=|b| or |a|+|b|=d. Godsil spectral-projector Schur squares diagonalize by Fourier characters; count equal energies for a,a+z by disjoint support one-counts t,u: 2t=|z| or 2u=d-|z|. Inclusion-exclusion gives the stated binomial fractions, positive precisely for even character parity and zero precisely for odd; even dimension makes parity invariant under quotient. Antipodal symmetry follows by character parity. For the gap, b_j=1-C(2j,j)/4^j is positive and discretely concave on j>0; its symmetric product maximizes at the center by log concavity. Recomputed Fourier equal-energy count exactly in d=6 and d=8, obtaining ranks 16,64 and gaps 11/16,39/64. Boundary d=4 is explicitly excluded from novelty; finite checks do not establish all even d.

value.rationale: The even halved cube is a canonical distance-regular cubelike transport graph. Complete nullspace equality identifies every time-averaged lost mode, and exact gap measures mixing contraction on all surviving modes; these are structural family invariants absent from the cited general framework, not a selected toy sample.

final_claim: For every even d>=6, unweighted adjacency continuous-time quantum average mixing on the distance-two halved d-cube has antipodal-antisymmetric kernel exactly, rank 2^(d-2), character spectrum mu_w=0 for w odd and alpha_w+alpha_(d-w)-alpha_w alpha_(d-w) for w even, and minimum positive eigenvalue 1-(1-alpha_(2 floor(d/4)))(1-alpha_(2 ceil(d/4))) asymptotic to 4/sqrt(pi d).
limitations: Only unweighted even-dimensional d>=6 halved cube, adjacency Hamiltonian and infinite-time Cesaro mixing; not transient uniform mixing or general weighted cubelike graphs.
Finite Fourier checks are corroboration, not all-dimensional proof.
